Quality Dental Implants, Made Affordable

Wondering how you can afford the dental treatment you need and want? At Roots Dental | Implant Center, we work with several financing partners to help make treatment more manageable through flexible monthly payment options.

See Your Financing Options
Want to speak to a real person for guidance?
Patient Spotlight
“My only regret is that I didn't start this sooner.”

1. Explore your options

Compare our trusted financing partners and find the payment option that best fits your needs.

2. Apply online

Complete a quick application online from home or with help from our team in the office.

3. Review your decision

Many applicants receive a decision quickly, helping them move forward with treatment sooner.

Lender Options

Each of our financing partners offers something different, from interest-free payment options to extended loan terms. Explore the options below to see which provider may best meet your financial needs.

Cherry
  • High approval rates for various credit types
  • No hard credit check to see options
  • Payment terms up to 24 months
Apply with Cherry
Proceed
  • Specialized in large dental loans
  • Extended terms up to 10 years
  • Lower monthly payments for implants
Apply with Proceed

Frequently Asked Questions

Will checking my financing options affect my credit score?

Several of our financing partners allow you to check available options or prequalify using a soft credit inquiry, which does not affect your credit score. A hard credit inquiry may be required when you accept or finalize certain financing offers. Review each provider’s terms before applying.

Are there application fees or upfront costs?

Application fees, down payments, and other costs vary by financing provider and payment plan. Some options may not require a down payment, while others may require an initial payment at the time of treatment.

Which financing provider should I choose?

The best option depends on your treatment cost, preferred monthly payment, desired repayment term, and credit profile. You are welcome to review more than one provider or ask our team for help understanding the available options.

Can I pay off my financing early?

Early-payment policies vary by provider. Some financing options do not have prepayment penalties, but you should review your individual agreement before accepting an offer.

Take the Next Step Toward a Healthier Smile

Explore your financing options or contact our team for help finding a payment solution that works for you.

Call Us!

Last Updated: Jan. 16, 2026

Roots Dental Implants is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website or use our services.

 

1. Information Collection
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you fill out a form, schedule an appointment, or contact us for support. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and any other details you provide.

 

2. Use of Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide and manage our dental services.
  • Communicate with you regarding appointments, care updates, and service notifications.
  • Provide customer support.

3. SMS and Mobile Information
No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. Information sharing to subcontractors in support services, such as customer service, is permitted. All other use case categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

 

4. Third-Party Sharing
Roots Dental Implants does not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to others. We do not share your data with third parties for the purpose of buying or selling leads. Information is only shared with subcontractors who assist in our standard business operations (such as our messaging platform or customer service tools) and only as necessary to provide our services to you.

 

5. Security
We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

 

6. Contact Information
If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, you may contact us using the information below:

Dr. Jacob Kaufman, DMD

Dr. Jacob Kaufman grew up in Newberg, Oregon, and now practices in Gresham, where he combines a passion for digital dentistry with a patient-centered approach to care. A graduate of the Oregon Health & Science University School of Dentistry, Dr. Kaufman completed advanced training through the California Implant Institute’s Fellowship in Implant Dentistry.

He specializes in guided implant surgery, digital treatment planning, and 3D-printed restorations—helping patients achieve lasting, comfortable, and natural results. Dedicated to continual growth, Dr. Kaufman stays at the forefront of modern implant and restorative techniques to help every patient reach their dental goals.

Outside the office, Dr. Kaufman enjoys life near the Roots Dental office with his partner Jan and their dogs, Dillard and Olive. He loves backpacking, golfing, and catching live music around Portland.

Flexible Payment and Financing Options Available

Here at Roots Dental Implant Center, we want you to be able to achieve the smile of your dreams! Although implants aren’t inexpensive, they are a great investment in your health that becomes affordable with great financing options. Peer reviewed research has proven the connection between oral health and whole body wellness. A healthy mouth reduces the risk of many diseases, including heart disease and diabetes. Investing in your smile is an investment in your overall wellbeing.

Dr. Chris Epperson, DMD

Dr. Chris Epperson earned his Doctor of Dental Medicine degree from A.T. Still University’s Arizona School of Dentistry & Oral Health in Mesa, Arizona. He first discovered his passion for dentistry while participating in humanitarian trips to Mexico and the Dominican Republic.

With an extensive background in implant dentistry, including full-mouth implant solutions, Dr. Epperson is a Fellow of the International Congress of Oral Implantologists and a member of the American Academy of Implant Dentistry.
